sections.heading: Dragon Copilot vs Dragon Medical One: Understanding the Difference
sections.content: Dragon Copilot and Dragon Medical One are both Microsoft/Nuance products but serve fundamentally different documentation workflows. Dragon Medical One is a traditional clinical speech recognition tool (dictation) - clinicians speak their notes section by section and the software transcribes with 99%+ accuracy. It's been the industry standard for 25+ years. Dragon Copilot, announced at HIMSS 2025, is Microsoft's unified AI clinical assistant that combines ambient capture, dictation capabilities, and GPT-4 generation to automatically create draft notes from patient conversations without requiring structured dictation.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Dragon Medical One has published pricing: $79-99/month depending on contract length (1-3 years), plus a mandatory $525 one-time implementation fee. Optional PowerMic hardware costs $300-650. Dragon Copilot uses enterprise custom pricing not publicly disclosed - it bundles DMO capabilities with DAX ambient AI and GPT-4 generation. For organizations wanting only dictation, Dragon Medical One is more cost-effective. For comprehensive AI documentation, Dragon Copilot's bundled approach may provide better value despite higher costs.

sections.heading: Ambient AI vs Dictation
sections.content: The core difference is passive vs active documentation. Dragon Copilot passively listens to patient-clinician conversations and generates draft notes automatically - the clinician reviews and approves rather than dictating. Dragon Medical One requires active dictation where clinicians structure and speak their notes. Dragon Copilot is ideal for conversational encounters; Dragon Medical One is preferred by clinicians who want precise control over documentation and have established dictation habits. Dragon Copilot extends to nurses with automatic structured documentation from nurse-patient interactions.

sections.heading: Platform & Compatibility
sections.content: Dragon Medical One is Windows-only for the desktop app (Mac users need Parallels/VM) while Dragon Copilot runs on Windows, macOS, Chromebook, and mobile. Dragon Medical One has been KLAS-validated as Best in Speech Recognition for 6 consecutive years with proven 99%+ accuracy. Dragon Copilot is newer but leverages Microsoft's Azure healthcare infrastructure and GPT-4. Both integrate deeply with Epic and Cerner.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: The choice depends on your preferred documentation workflow:

recommendations.when: You want hands-free ambient documentation where AI generates notes from conversations and you review/approve
You prefer structured dictation with precise control over note content and have established dictation habits
You're a health system wanting a unified platform for physicians and nurses with AI-generated documentation
You want transparent per-user pricing ($79-99/month) without enterprise sales conversations
You need proven 99%+ accuracy and KLAS-validated speech recognition that's been refined over 25 years

faqs.q: What's the difference between Dragon Copilot and Dragon Medical One?
faqs.a: Dragon Medical One is a dictation tool where you speak your notes and it transcribes them with 99%+ accuracy. Dragon Copilot is an ambient AI that passively listens to patient conversations and auto-generates draft notes using GPT-4. Copilot includes DMO capabilities plus ambient AI.

faqs.q: Is Dragon Medical One being replaced by Dragon Copilot?
faqs.a: No, both products continue to be available. Dragon Medical One remains the choice for clinicians who prefer structured dictation. Dragon Copilot is for those wanting ambient AI documentation. Dragon Copilot bundles DMO's dictation capabilities with ambient features.

faqs.q: Does Dragon Medical One work on Mac?
faqs.a: The Dragon Medical One native app is Windows-only. Mac users need to use Parallels or a virtual machine to run the Windows app. The PowerMic Mobile app works on iOS. Dragon Copilot has better Mac support.

faqs.q: How much does Dragon Medical One cost?
faqs.a: Dragon Medical One costs $79-99/month depending on contract length (1-3 years), plus a mandatory $525 one-time implementation fee. Annual costs range from $948-$1,188 plus setup.
